info.title: Shellfish Agentic Credit API
info.description: Frontend source of truth for the current hackathon HTTP API. Schemas mirror the shared C0-REP-1 / REP-CURVE-v0.2 models. Amounts use exact strings and explicit scales. Examples are synthetic C0 fixtures, not native ledger receipts. LIVE_DEVNET and SIMULATED_LOAN remain explicit. An ALLOW is not settlement, an informational quote is not permission, and a configured ledger handle is not native proof. No HTTP authentication scheme is declared by this demo contract.

servers.description: Local API. Configure VITE_API_BASE_URL for the frontend.

get.description: Process health and configured mode. This response does not establish ledger readiness.
The same checked-in document is served by the API. It describes the current frontend contract.

get.summary: Read execution mode and public signing identifiers
get.description: Public fields only. live_ready indicates configured handles, not a validated loan. Never contains wallet seeds.

post.description: Omitted mandate uses the current demo/default material. This route validates the current kernel input. It does not by itself reserve credit or issue a signature.

503.description: Native or credit backend not configured.

get.description: Evidence is a versioned source attestation. Registry balances are read separately. Native mode needs a loaded native-bound source.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Principal subject ID, for example business:harbor-supply-demo.

post.description: Supply either subject_id for a loaded passport or evidence. The lender retains underwriting authority. Same C0 evidence gives lender-A approval and lender-B decline.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lender ID, for example lender-A or lender-B.

200.description: Lender approval or decline. A decline is a successful business response.

value.human_explanation: Requires 12 months of accepted history. The synthetic evidence covers 6 months.

post.summary: Match firm offers to mandate limits
post.description: Matching grants no permission. Preserve the returned firm offer and its commitments for authorization.

400.description: Invalid mandate/offer, missing offers or mode mismatch.

get.description: Amounts are exact monetary minor-unit strings. The facility is one lender limit, separate from REP.

get.summary: Read current credit and REP state
get.description: One SQLite read snapshot supplies facility headroom, participating exposure and all REP buckets. A pending return credit is not available REP.

post.summary: Preview REP bond and remaining capacity
post.description: Read-only. No reservation, nonce consumption, ALLOW or signature. Final authorization recomputes against its atomic snapshot.

200.description: Informational quote, including capacity denial reasons.

400.description: Invalid positive principal or contract mismatch.

post.summary: Authorize and reserve the exact action
post.description: Successful ALLOW atomically reserves facility capacity and REP before any controlled signature. Reuse request/idempotency identity for exact retries. The demo unique option changes request IDs only, not the mandate nonce. Omitted sources use the configured demo/native material.

400.description: Malformed or inconsistent commitments or reservation.

403.description: Policy DENY receipt. No new signature is issued.

503.description: Native or credit backend not configured.

post.description: Use request_id, reservation_id and proposal_hash from the receipt. Supplied commercial terms must equal the saved approved offer. Native mode redeems REP before LoanSet. A pending/unknown submission must not be displayed as validated success.

200.description: Loan result and updated receipt. Simulation keeps txHash null.

get.description: Read the registry loan state. Native validation is represented by recorded ledger evidence, not by merely having a loan ID.
Lookup by request ID or reservation ID. The response includes a Devnet explorer link only for a recorded native transaction hash.

get.summary: Read the joined credit and transaction view
get.description: The frontend polling/read endpoint joins persisted request state, receipt, approved offer, current credit status and recorded transaction references. Ledger hashes alone do not contain the off-chain approval or aggregate participating exposure. Registry-event flags are recorded evidence and are not a fresh ledger re-query. No signed blobs are exposed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Request ID from an authorization receipt.

syntheticPending.summary: Synthetic C0 pending reservation with saved lender approval

409.description: Persisted receipt/offer context or mode does not match this request. Codes include UI_STATE_CONTEXT_MISMATCH and DENY_UNSUPPORTED_NETWORK.

post.description: Uses the current mode. This endpoint is a hackathon orchestration helper. REP restoration remains a separate verified issuer return. A principal reduction is not the LoanPay spending-cap Amount.

200.description: Repayment result and updated registry status.

AtomicAmount.description: Unsigned exact integer encoded as a decimal string. Monetary values use the supplied money_scale. REP uses 1,000,000 atomic units per REP. Never parse these for permission decisions with floating-point arithmetic.

MoneyAmount.description: Display monetary units with exactly two decimal places. This is separate from atomic principal_minor.

Commitment.description: Application SHA-256 commitment over SORTED_KEYS_JSON_UTF8_V1. This is not an XRPL transaction hash.

AssetRef.description: Exact asset identity. XRP has no issuer. Issued currencies include issuer. MPT uses its 48-hex issuance ID.

ReputationState.description: seed_u + growth_u = available_u + reserved_u + bonded_u + pending_return_u + forfeited_u. Runtime Zod and registry enforce this cross-field invariant.

AuthorizationReceipt.description: Decision and execution snapshot. A transaction timeout is unresolved. SIMULATED_LOAN must have tx_hash null and native_signing_permitted false. Runtime also requires ALLOW, reservation, stake proof and prepared commitment before native signing permission.

CreditQuote.description: Read-only preview. grants_permission is always false. Final authorization recomputes the bond and atomically reserves capacity and REP.

LoanRecord.description: Public persisted registry loan record. Principal and REP amounts remain decimal strings. Unix times are seconds. Fields reflect the current accounting snapshot.

live_ready.description: Application ledger/configuration handles exist. This does not establish ledger proof or completed native acceptance.

evidence_fresh.description: Current demo evidence flag. It does not authenticate native evidence.

unique.description: Demo request ID generation only. It does not create a new signed mandate nonce. For exact retry, retain the original request.

ReceiptResponse.description: Decision and execution snapshot. A transaction timeout is unresolved. SIMULATED_LOAN must have tx_hash null and native_signing_permitted false. Runtime also requires ALLOW, reservation, stake proof and prepared commitment before native signing permission.

amount.description: Repayment amount passed to the configured adapter. Simulation uses display money. Native representation must match the selected loan asset precision. This amount is not proof of actual principal reduction.

recorded_validated.description: The registry event records a native validated flag. This view does not re-query the ledger.

LenderDecisionSnapshot.description: Projection from the saved lender-approved offer. It does not run new underwriting. Null means no saved approval, not a lender decline.

x-source-models.runtime_semantics: Zod refinements and registry transactions enforce cross-field rules beyond JSON Schema.
